title: Cache, performance and homepage LCP remediation

homepage_lcp.emitted_html_issue: renderer outputs loading="lazy" on the above-the-fold image and no fetchpriority=high

litespeed_vpi.capability: VPI can preload viewport images and add fetchpriority=high; external QUIC.cloud service is required for generation
litespeed_vpi.reason_not_enabled: Would enable an external QUIC.cloud optimization service that can consume quota or incur fees; not necessary to prove the current root cause.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 35424563015 raw DB read

litespeed_lazy_excludes.reason: The LCP image is already emitted by the theme with native loading=lazy; adding a LiteSpeed lazy exclude would not safely prove removal of the theme-emitted attribute.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 35424480301 raw DB read

blockers.reason: The specific above-the-fold slider renderer is ionCube-protected. Removing its native loading=lazy / adding direct fetchpriority requires changing protected theme behavior or a supported theme setting not exposed by the guarded gateway.

No litespeed_no_cache post meta exists on sampled singular routes, readable custom-plugin/theme code did not expose the cause, and the singular entry templates are ionCube-protected. Prior force/public/comment/ESI experiments did not remove no-cache.

next_safe_action: Obtain a supported IranKala theme setting/update or an allow-listed LiteSpeed/QUIC.cloud configuration path that does not require protected-code modification or paid-service activation; do not repeat completed A/B tests.
